description_text: **About the Role** Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We’re building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team will be focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race–and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match (millions of Uber trips every hour across cities, conditions, and edge cases create the data autonomy has been missing). We will build platforms that harness scale and real-world complexity to reimagine how the world moves. You will be a software engineer in AV Labs and involved in the development and implementation of the latest technology for self driving stacks. The ideal candidate will be able to identify issues, provide solutions and implement the fixes as well as setting a high technical excellence bar in all things we do. **What the Candidate Will Do:** 1. Design the in vehicle software infrastructure. 2. Performance tuning. 3. Build the developer tools for robotics software development. **Basic Qualifications:** 1. Minimum 2 years of working experience in the software engineering industry 2. Bachelor degree in computer science, computer engineering or related fields 3. Proficient in Python, C++ and Linux 4. Experience with the Robot Operating System. **Preferred Qualifications:** 1. Experience in vehicle sensor technologies 2. Experience with sensor calibration, time synchronization 3. Experience with NVIDIA Drive OS. For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$171,000 per year - USD$190,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link [https://jobs.uber.com/en/benefits](https://jobs.uber.com/en/benefits). **About the Role** Uber Eats is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Account Executive to join our SMB G&R Sales Team. The Account Executive role is a great opportunity to demonstrate your sales experience to expand the number of G&R merchants that partner with Uber Eats. Your primary focus will be bringing on new merchants (alcohol) that fit our partnership criteria, and use your prospecting and negotiation skills through cold-calling and driving internal processes to set up our partnerships for success. As an Account Executive, you will lead the full sales cycle and sign partnerships with top local G&R merchants while being a champion for the Uber and Uber Eats brands. Your success in this role is measured by achieving and exceeding your quarterly quota and proactively building your pipeline by managing and hitting the weekly metrics (cold calls, emails, opportunities created). **What the Candidate Will Need:** - Prospect and build pipeline to create partnerships with the best SMB G&R merchants interested in Uber Eats - Manage contract negotiations aimed at establishing the foundation of a strong working relationship with our SMB partners, including sustainable economics for both parties - Communicate the value of Uber Eats and its newest products to prospects with a consultative approach - Achieve and consistently exceed quarterly sales goals - White glove the onboarding experience following the initial close - Help us identify and build best practices for your sales team and others **Basic Qualifications** - At least 2 year of experience in full-cycle sales **Preferred Qualifications:** - 3+ years of full-cycle sales experience - Passionate about sales and helping SMB merchants grow their business with Uber Eats - Bachelor's Degree or equivalent - Experience with cold calling 50+ prospects per day - Excited to learn and have no fear of picking up the phone - this is a great role to grow or build your career in sales - Ability to work through ambiguity - Proven achievement in performance-based role - Effective communication with colleagues and clients - Experience multi-tasking work with attention to detail - Coachability, interest in implementing feedback, and dedication to building your brand For Chicago, IL-based roles: The base hourly rate range for this role is USD$29.09 per hour - USD$32.34 per hour. **About the Role** Uber is launching **AV Labs** to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We’re building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match. As a ML Engineer, you will be at the forefront of **Physical AI**, developing core components of our **Autonomous Driving** stack. You will be responsible for the development and implementation of the latest machine learning techniques across **the autonomy** systems. The ideal candidate will be able to identify complex edge cases, provide robust algorithmic solutions, and set a high technical excellence bar. You will collaborate with engineers across big data, compute, and cloud engineering to build platforms that harness scale and real-world complexity to reimagine how the world moves. **What You Will Do** - **Autonomous Driving Algorithm Development:** Develop algorithms to tackle complex urban environments, focusing on robustness and safety. - **End-to-End AI Implementation:** Implement end-to-end AI-driven state-of-the-art methods for autonomy pipelines, leveraging massive-scale real-world data. - **Dataset Optimization:** Deliver high-quality datasets to accelerate ML technologies through advanced sensor data collection, processing, and auto-labeling. - **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with platform, product, and security engineering teams to enable the successful deployment of the latest machine learning techniques into production. **Basic Qualifications** - 2+ years of working experience in the ML/Robotics industry. - Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields. - Proficient in Python and Linux environments. - Familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch). **Preferred Qualifications** - Experience in the Autonomous Driving domain. - Proven track record of deploying ML models in safety-critical physical systems. - Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Vision, Robotics, or Machine Learning. - Familiarity with C++ and high-performance computing. For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$171,000 per year - USD$190,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link [https://jobs.uber.com/en/benefits](https://jobs.uber.com/en/benefits). **About the Role** We seek a skilled and experienced Performance Marketer to support our paid channel strategy for the delivery vertical (Uber Eats) in APAC. You will craft the global performance marketing strategy for delivery across our paid channels (SEM, Display, Social & Affiliate). You will work closely with regional leads to ensure the delivery strategy is adapted to local challenges and opportunities. **What You'll Do** - Build the paid channel strategy for our delivery business in collaboration with strategy & planning, operations, and finance teams. - Build plans in collaboration with channel excellence teams that guide the execution of the paid channels strategy for our delivery business. - Proactively monitor and report on performance and insights, then provide strategic recommendations on how paid channels can address local marketing challenges. - Work closely with channel excellence teams to turn initiatives launched by the delivery vertical into globally scaled solutions. **Basic Qualifications** - 4+ years of experience in performance marketing, specifically in building multi-channel and cross-channel strategies - Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Economics, or equivalent experience - Ability to analyze and structure data, turn data into insights, and insights into actions that assist senior management and other business leaders with decision-making - High level of business acumen with an analytical approach **Preferred Qualifications** - Experience working in ROAS performance marketing framework with familiarity with AdTech and incrementality measurement approaches. - Experience owning large Performance Marketing budgets - Strong stakeholder management skills - Strategic thinker who can take large business problems and turn them into action plans that drive outcomes - Strong communicator with the ability to create high-impact materials with clear narratives, strategic vision, and performance outcomes - A proactive, ambitious approach where you actively seek opportunities that enhance business growth impact - Organized with the ability to establish and communicate priorities within a complex organization - A hard-working, thorough, organized, and motivated self-starter, constantly striving to improve your skills and look for ways to contribute to the team. Thrives on challenges and is not deterred by complicated/complex situations For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$140,000 per year - USD$155,500 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. **About the Role** AV Labs is seeking a Software Engineer to join our specialized mobile team. This role is central to the development and optimization of high-fidelity user interfaces for in-vehicle monitoring and diagnostic systems. You will design and maintain applications for Android-based hardware that interface directly with embedded computing units to provide real-time visualization of complex environmental sensor data. This position requires a versatile developer capable of working across native Android and modern web stacks to bridge the gap between sophisticated backend data processing and intuitive, low-latency user experiences. **What the Candidate Will Do :** 1. Application Development: Design and implement robust applications for specialized tablet form factors using the Android SDK and modern Web frameworks. 2. Data Visualization: Develop high-performance visualization frameworks for multi-sensor inputs. 3. System Integration: Collaborate on the development of communication protocols to ensure seamless data transmission between the compute station and the display interface. 4. Validation & Performance Tuning: Participate in field testing to troubleshoot hardware-software integration. **Basic Qualifications:** 1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 2. Experience in web/mobile development 3. Familiarity with synchronous programming and state management patterns. 4. Understanding of standard networking protocols. **Preferred Qualifications:** 1. Prior exposure to Native-to-Web communication. 2. Familiarity with 3D rendering concepts or spatial data visualization. 3. Experience in robotics, autonomous systems, or hardware-software integration. For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$171,000 per year - USD$190,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link [https://jobs.uber.com/en/benefits](https://jobs.uber.com/en/benefits). **About the Role** Uber AI’s mission is to optimize and advance Uber’s products and operations through cutting-edge machine learning and AI technologies. The organization comprises several teams, including the Machine Learning Platform team, which enables scalable ML across Uber. We provides foundational components to empower product teams in creating innovative and personalized user experiences. The broader group brings together machine learning engineers, backend and mobile engineers working collaboratively to solve high-impact business challenges. **What the Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points** \-\-\-\- What the Candidate Will Do ---- 1. Design and develop software and tools (pipeline build infrastructure) that power a state-of-the-art machine learning platform 2. Lead system architecture design efforts, including the integration and management of upstream and downstream dependencies 3. Drive operational efficiency through automation in areas such as capacity planning, configuration management, performance optimization, monitoring, and root cause analysis 4. Participate in on-call rotations and provide timely support for critical production issues \-\-\-\- Basic Qualifications ---- 1. Minimum of 4 years of experience in systems software engineering, with a strong foundation in computer architecture and core computer science principles 2. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience 3. Proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: Java, Go, Python, or C/C++ 4. Solid working knowledge of networking, Linux, Docker, databases, and distributed processing technologies such as Ray, Hadoop, Hive, and/or Spark \-\-\-\- Preferred Qualifications ---- 1. Proven experience in designing, building, and operating distributed systems and high-throughput services 2. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and computational complexity 3. Demonstrates grit, initiative, and a strong sense of ownership, alongside a collaborative mindset and leadership capabilities 4. Hands-on experience using machine learning frameworks in production environments For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$171,000 per year - USD$190,000 per year.
